query:
SELECT a.id, a.title, COUNT(at.tagId) as tag_count
FROM articles a
LEFT JOIN articleTags at ON a.id = at.articleId
GROUP BY a.id, a.title
HAVING tag_count < 5
ORDER BY tag_count ASC;
